declarations.name: Elastica.affine_density_curvature_expression
declarations.signature:
theorem affine_density_curvature_expression (κ M E M'' σ a b : ℝ) :
    M'' + κ ^ 2 * (M + a) - κ * (E + a * κ + b) - (σ - b) * κ =
      M'' + κ ^ 2 * M - κ * E - σ * κ

declarations.name: Elastica.affine_density_shift_same_end_angles
declarations.signature:
theorem affine_density_shift_same_end_angles {ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (a b ℓ : ℝ) (h0 : θ 0 = ψ 0) (hℓ : θ ℓ = ψ ℓ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ - energy ε θ ℓ =
      energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) ψ ℓ - energy ε ψ ℓ

declarations.name: Elastica.angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length
declarations.signature:
theorem angle_eq_initial_of_xCoord_eq_length {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x₀ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₀ + ℓ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0

declarations.name: Elastica.angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial
declarations.signature:
theorem angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s = θ s

declarations.name: Elastica.angle_scaling_endpoints
declarations.signature:
theorem angle_scaling_endpoints (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = θ 0 ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = θ ℓ

declarations.name: Elastica.angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s - θ s = ψ 0 - θ 0

declarations.name: Elastica.angleEquation_of_stationary
declarations.signature:
theorem angleEquation_of_stationary {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)

declarations.name: Elastica.angleForce_hasDerivAt
declarations.signature:
theorem angleForce_hasDerivAt {θ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ s : ℝ}
    (hθ : HasDerivAt θ (κ s) s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => -lam * sin (θ t) + μ * cos (θ t))
      (-(lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * κ s) s

declarations.signature: def angleVariation (θ η : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: Elastica.augmented_integral_eq_residual
declarations.signature:
theorem augmented_integral_eq_residual {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-deriv M s + q s) * η.val s

declarations.name: Elastica.augmented_stationary_iff_residual_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem augmented_stationary_iff_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q) :
    (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0) ↔
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s

declarations.name: Elastica.augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q)
    (hEL : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s) :
    ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0

declarations.name: Elastica.boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals
declarations.signature:
theorem boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals {θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ))
    (hx : (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s))
    (hy : (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s))
    (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    θ 0 = φ 0 ∧ θ ℓ = φ ℓ ∧
      xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = xCoord φ x₀ ℓ ∧ yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = yCoord φ y₀ ℓ

declarations.name: Elastica.constrained_secondVariation_corrected
declarations.signature:
theorem constrained_secondVariation_corrected
    {ε θ η a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s)^2 -
        (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η s)^2) 0

declarations.name: Elastica.constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected
declarations.signature:
theorem constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected
    {ε θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)) 0

    {θ κ ε : ℝ → ℝ} {lam μ σ s : ℝ}
    (hsecond : deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (κ t))) s =
      -(lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * κ s)

          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))

theorem exists_normalized_constraint_directions {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}

    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) (p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :

        p.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * v s),
       p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * u s) +

declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
        -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
        (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
        deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)

declarations.name: Elastica.locallyMinimizing_iff_exponentialWeight_local_maximum
declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_exponentialWeight_local_maximum
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ

        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,

      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =

theorem locallyMinimizing_middle_replacement_comparison
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ →
      EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a) → EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ) →
      (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s)) →
      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) ≤ (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) ∧
        exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ

declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_necessary_conditions
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ,
      (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
          -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
        (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
          lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
        (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
          (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
          deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)) ∧
      (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)

declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_classical_equations
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ κ₀ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)

theorem locallyMinimizing_secondVariation_nonneg

declarations.name: Elastica.middle_replacement_boundary_and_weight_ratio
declarations.signature:
theorem middle_replacement_boundary_and_weight_ratio
    {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ))
    (hx : (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s))
    (hy : (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s))
    (β x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    (θ 0 = φ 0 ∧ θ ℓ = φ ℓ ∧
      xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = xCoord φ x₀ ℓ ∧ yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = yCoord φ y₀ ℓ) ∧
    exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ / exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exp (-β * ((∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) -
        (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))))

declarations.name: Elastica.powerLog_exponentialWeight_split
declarations.signature:
theorem powerLog_exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (p β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) =
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) +
      powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))) +
      p * powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) *
        powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s))))

declarations.name: Elastica.quadratic_curvature_equation
declarations.signature:
theorem quadratic_curvature_equation
    {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {k σ s : ℝ} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 κ)
    (h : deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ t))) s +
      κ s ^ 2 * deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ s) -
      κ s * (k * (κ s) ^ 2 / 2) - σ * κ s = 0) :
    k * deriv (deriv κ) s + k * (κ s) ^ 3 / 2 - σ * κ s = 0

declarations.name: Elastica.quadratic_curvature_expression
declarations.signature:
theorem quadratic_curvature_expression (k κ κ'' σ : ℝ) :
    k * κ'' + κ ^ 2 * (k * κ) - κ * (k * κ ^ 2 / 2) - σ * κ =
      k * κ'' + k * κ ^ 3 / 2 - σ * κ

theorem reconstruction_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}

    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,

declarations.signature:
theorem reconstruction_rotation_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ α : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (hα : α = ψ 0 - θ 0) (x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      xCoord ψ x₁ s - x₁ =
        cos α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) - sin α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀) ∧
      yCoord ψ y₁ s - y₁ =
        sin α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) + cos α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)

theorem scaled_boundary_data {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a ℓ x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ α β : ℝ}

    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₁) (hy : yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = y₁)
    (hα : θ 0 = α) (hβ : θ ℓ = β) :
    0 < a * ℓ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s => θ (s / a)) ∧
      xCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * x₀) (a * ℓ) = a * x₁ ∧
      yCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * y₀) (a * ℓ) = a * y₁ ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = α ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = β

theorem secondVariation_augmentedEnergy {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}

theorem smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature

    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,

theorem stationary_iff_exponentialWeight_stationary {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)

        deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s)) 0 = 0 →

declarations.name: Elastica.stationary_multipliers
declarations.signature:
theorem stationary_multipliers {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hM : Continuous M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) +
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0

declarations.name: LinearInputAreaExactVariation.exists_exact_area_variation
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_exact_area_variation {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hηx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηa : (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ, ∃ a b c : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 c 0 ∧
      a 0 = 0 ∧ b 0 = 0 ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt a 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt b 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt c 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) ∧
        LinearInputAreaVariation.area
          (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ =
            LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ

theorem exists_implicit_correction {f : Parameters → ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) = 0)
    (hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ))) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g 0 ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt g 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, f (t, g t) = f 0

declarations.name: LinearInputAreaExactVariation.fderiv_constraintParameters_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem fderiv_constraintParameters_zero {θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hξ₁ : Continuous ξ₁) (hξ₂ : Continuous ξ₂) (hξ₃ : Continuous ξ₃)
    (p : Parameters) :
    fderiv ℝ (constraintParameters θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ ℓ) 0 p =
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p),
       ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p),
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) *
          parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p)))

declarations.name: LinearInputAreaExactVariation.integral_parameterLinear
declarations.signature:
theorem integral_parameterLinear {η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ w : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hη : Continuous η) (hξ₁ : Continuous ξ₁) (hξ₂ : Continuous ξ₂)
    (hξ₃ : Continuous ξ₃) (hw : Continuous w) (p : Parameters) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * parameterLinear η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ s p) =
      p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * η s) +
      p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₁ s) +
      p.2.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₂ s) +
      p.2.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, w s * ξ₃ s)

theorem corrected_family_C1_close {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ)
    {a b c : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0) (hc : ContinuousAt c 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hc0 : c 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |(θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) - θ s| < r ∧
      |deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u + c t * ξ₃.val u) s -
        deriv θ s| < r

theorem hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_feasible {k ℓ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}

declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hmin : LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ) {a b c : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0) (hc : ContinuousAt c 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hc0 : c 0 = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos
        (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin
        (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) ∧
      LinearInputAreaVariation.area
        (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ =
          LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ) :
    IsLocalMin (fun t => energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2)
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ) 0

declarations.name: LinearInputAreaMinimum.locallyMinimizing_phase_energy
declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_phase_energy {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      LinearInputDesign.E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (LinearInputGradient.gy (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-LinearInputGradient.gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s

    ((1 / 2) * ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q) * η q) * sin (θ s) +
          xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s) -
        ((∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q) * η q) * cos (θ s) +
          yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))) =
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) -
      (xCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        yCoord θ 0 ℓ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) * η s)) / 2

theorem hasDerivAt_area_variation_feasible {θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}

    (hx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η s) = 0)
    (hy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => area (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η s) 0

declarations.signature:
theorem hasDerivAt_area_variation_raw {θ η : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => area (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      ((1 / 2) * ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        (∫ q in 0..s, -sin (θ q) * η q) * sin (θ s) +
          xCoord θ 0 s * (cos (θ s) * η s) -
        ((∫ q in 0..s, cos (θ q) * η q) * cos (θ s) +
          yCoord θ 0 s * (-sin (θ s) * η s))) 0

declarations.name: LinearInputCoupledConsequences.exists_global_convergent_solution
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_global_convergent_solution {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hPhi : ContDiff ℝ 1 Phi)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (q₀ : State n) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) :
    ∃ M : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ M i) ∧ ∃ q : ℝ → State n, q 0 = q₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, |(q t).2 i| ≤ M i) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 - target ∧
        E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 - target ≤
          (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2 - target) * Real.exp
            (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2)) * t)) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        Metric.infDist (q t).1 {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target} ≤
          bandRadius lam r u (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) /
            (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) *
            (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2 - target) * Real.exp
              (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2)) * t)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2) atTop (𝓝 target) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => Metric.infDist (q t).1
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target}) atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: LinearInputCoupledConsequences.exists_global_injective_convergent_solution
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_global_injective_convergent_solution {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hPhi : ContDiff ℝ 1 Phi)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (q₀ : State n) (hinit : target < E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) :
    ∃ q : ℝ → State n, q 0 = q₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → target < E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (fun t => E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      InjOn (fun t => (q t).1) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2) atTop (𝓝 target) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => Metric.infDist (q t).1
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target}) atTop (𝓝 0)

    (hmin : LinearInputAreaMinimum.LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ)

declarations.signature:
theorem decomposition_of_rate {px py vx vy gamma gap : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)
    (hrate : px * vx + py * vy = -gamma * gap * (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) :
    vx = -gamma * gap * px -
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * py ∧
      vy = -gamma * gap * py +
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * px

declarations.signature:
theorem energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback {lam r u x y vx vy gamma target : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < gSq lam r u x y) :
    (gx lam r u x y * vx + gy x y * vy =
      -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gSq lam r u x y) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gx lam r u x y - b * gy x y ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gy x y + b * gx lam r u x y

theorem energy_rate_iff_exists_unique_feedback_on_band
    {lam r u x y vx vy gamma target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (he : target ≤ E lam r u x y) :
    (gx lam r u x y * vx + gy x y * vy =
      -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gSq lam r u x y) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gx lam r u x y - b * gy x y ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gy x y + b * gx lam r u x y

theorem feedback_rate (px py gamma gap b : ℝ) :
    px * (-gamma * gap * px - b * py) +

        -gamma * gap * (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)

declarations.signature:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_iff_exists_unique_feedback
    {x y : ℝ → ℝ} {t vx vy lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hx : HasDerivAt x vx t) (hy : HasDerivAt y vy t)
    (hpos : 0 < gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s))
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gx lam r u (x t) (y t) - b * gy (x t) (y t) ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gy (x t) (y t) + b * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)

            (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2)) * t)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2) atTop (𝓝 target)

declarations.name: LinearInputMainResult.circle_nonzero_input
declarations.signature:
theorem circle_nonzero_input {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    LinearInputAreaMinimum.LocallyMinimizing 1 (fun s => s) ℓ ∧
    LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary 1 1 (fun s => s) ℓ ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ,
      deriv (deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => t))) s +
        (deriv (fun t : ℝ => t) s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        (-1 / 2) * deriv (fun t : ℝ => t) s = 1) ∧
    E (1 / 2) (1 / 2) 1 1 (sqrt 2) = -5 / 8 ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (gy 1 (sqrt 2)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => sqrt 2)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (1 / 2) 1 1 (sqrt 2)) s)

declarations.name: LinearInputMainResult.circle_pressure_firstIntegral
declarations.signature:
theorem circle_pressure_firstIntegral (p s : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => deriv (fun r : ℝ => r) t) s =
      p * (xCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * cos s + yCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * sin s) -
        p * sin s ∧
    (deriv (fun r : ℝ => r) s) ^ 2 / 2 -
      (p - p * yCoord (fun r => r) 0 s) * cos s -
      p * xCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * sin s = 1 / 2 - p

declarations.name: LinearInputMainResult.locallyMinimizing_pressure_curvature_phase
declarations.signature:
theorem locallyMinimizing_pressure_curvature_phase {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hmin : LinearInputAreaMinimum.LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ c : ℝ,
      LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary k p θ ℓ ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
          σ * deriv θ s = p) ∧
        E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
        HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
          (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
          (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
            (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
        (deriv (deriv θ) s) ^ 2 / 2 + (deriv θ s) ^ 4 / 8 -
          σ * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / (2 * k) - (p / k) * deriv θ s = c

      StrictAntiOn (fun t => E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (z t).1 (z t).2)

theorem pressure_angle_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p

declarations.signature:
theorem pressure_angle_eq_phase_energy
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv (fun t => k * deriv θ t) s =
      p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s

declarations.name: LinearInputPressureCurvature.pressure_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
declarations.signature:
theorem pressure_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ k p lam μ : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => k * deriv θ t)
      (p * (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) -
        lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) s) :
    ∃ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (k * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        (lam - p * yCoord θ 0 s) * cos (θ s) -
        (μ + p * xCoord θ 0 s) * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        σ * deriv θ s = p)

    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {p lam μ s : ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ) :

    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hband : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),

    ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧

declarations.signature:
theorem exists_local_coordinate_solution {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ x y : ℝ → ℝ, x 0 = x₀ ∧ y 0 = y₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε,
        HasDerivAt x
          (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)
            - b (x t, y t) * gy (x t) (y t)) t ∧
        HasDerivAt y
          (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) * gy (x t) (y t)
            + b (x t, y t) * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)) t

theorem exists_local_solution {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z t₀ = z₀ ∧ ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - ε) (t₀ + ε),
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t

declarations.signature:
theorem exists_local_solution_energy_formula {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ T > (0 : ℝ), ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 - target =
          (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2 - target) *
            Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, gSq lam r u (z s).1 (z s).2))

declarations.signature:
theorem exists_local_solution_one_add_sq {Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hQ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Q)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z t₀ = z₀ ∧ ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - ε) (t₀ + ε),
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target (fun q => 1 + Q q ^ 2) (z t)) t

declarations.name: LinearInputTrajectoryExistence.exists_local_unique_solution
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_local_unique_solution {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z t₀ = z₀ ∧
      IsIntegralCurveAt z (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t₀ ∧
      ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, w t₀ = z₀ →
        IsIntegralCurveAt w (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t₀ →
        z =ᶠ[𝓝 t₀] w
